verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5090 is a graphics card, so in-product AI insights and suggestions drawn from a user's data are a software/SaaS feature, not something a GPU ships. The pack's AI features (DLSS frame generation, upscaling, Ray Reconstruction, Tensor Core throughput) generate pixels and frames, not insights about user data. Nothing in the evidence shows such a feature, so the axis does not apply.
